summary: @servicetitan/eslint-config preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's `preinstall` script (setup.mjs) fires automatically on `npm install` and downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, then uses that alternate runtime via `execFileSync(bunPath, ['math_init.js'])` to execute a sibling file. The sibling `math_init.js` is a 727 KB single-line obfuscated bundle (hex-mangled identifiers, string-array rotator function `WV8StW`, encoded charcode dictionary arrays, no readable strings). setup.mjs itself is obfuscator-mangled (`_0xNNNN` identifiers, per-function key-remap objects) hiding control flow around the network fetch and process execution. An ESLint configuration package has no legitimate need for the Bun runtime or a large opaque payload executed at install time. The pattern — install-time download of an alternate runtime specifically to execute a bundled obfuscated payload — evades Node-focused scanners and does not match the package's advertised purpose of providing ESLint rules.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
